name: POST /api/admin/voice-agent/calls/:call_id/transfer - Escalate a live AI call to a human with the summary attached
description: OPERATOR route (x-admin-ops-token = ADMIN_OPS_TOKEN), called by the voice runtime when its agent escalates (built-in transfer_to_human tool): an escalation transfers the caller to a human with the call summary attached (1bdbfb86-09c3-410e-bcee-be79df98074d#AC4). The human is the agent version's escalation_rules.transfer { number (E.164), persona_id?, mode?: refer | bridge }. Body: summary (required, <= 2000 chars, written by the runtime), reason, room (the call's LiveKit room, required), caller_identity, caller_is_sip, transcript ([{ speaker, text }], last 40 lines kept). It creates an sdk-handoff (pending, cs_owner = the human persona, metadata { kind: voice_transfer, call_id, agent_id, caller_number, reason, summary, transcript, transcript_url, target_number, transfer_mode }), then moves the caller: SIP REFER of the SIP caller's leg (LiveKit SIP.TransferSIPParticipant tel:number), else dials the human into the room over the tenant's outbound trunk (bridge), else no media change (callback — the handoff asks the human to call back). The call becomes transferred (not for callback), context.transfer records { handoff_id, mode, target_number, ref }, and voice.call.transferred.v1 is emitted. 200 { call_id, handoff_id, mode (refer | bridge | callback), target_number, note? }. Errors: missing summary or room 400; unknown call 404; call ended or already transferred 409 Conflict; the version has no transfer target 409 TransferNotConfigured; LiveKit failure 502 MediaError (the handoff stays pending with the error); missing/wrong ops token 401/403. The fixture chain's agent version has no escalation_rules.transfer, so the runner reaches 409 TransferNotConfigured on its test-session call — the refer / bridge / callback paths are proven by the voice-runtime e2e.

testCases.name: The fixture agent has no transfer target -> 409 TransferNotConfigured
